crossRefs.note: Hezekiah sent to all Israel and Judah, and wrote letters also to Ephraim and Manasseh, that they should come to…
So the couriers passed from city to city through the country of Ephraim and Manasseh, even to Zebulun, but people…
Nevertheless some men of Asher, Manasseh, and Zebulun humbled themselves, and came to Jerusalem.
Now when all this was finished, all Israel who were present went out to the cities of Judah, and broke the pillars in…
Moreover the altar that was at Bethel, and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, had…
but all the Israelites went down to the Philistines, each man to sharpen his own plowshare, mattock, ax, and sickle.
The price was one payim each to sharpen mattocks, plowshares, pitchforks, axes, and goads.
A man who gives false testimony against his neighbor is like a club, a sword, or a sharp arrow.

people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

people.name: Naphtali
people.line: Son of Jacob, founder of the tribe of Naphtali.

people.name: Simeon
people.line: Son of Jacob and Leah, one of the twelve tribes.

translations.web: He did this in the cities of Manasseh, Ephraim, and Simeon, even to Naphtali, around in their ruins.
translations.bsb: Josiah did the same in the cities of Manasseh, Ephraim, and Simeon, as far as Naphtali, and in the ruins around them.
translations.kjv: And so did he in the cities of Manasseh, and Ephraim, and Simeon, even unto Naphtali, with their mattocks round about.
translations.asv: And so did he in the cities of Manasseh and Ephraim and Simeon, even unto Naphtali, in their ruins round about.
